text: The agent was extending signup email validation to normalize addresses (trimming, lowercasing, and collapsing Gmail dot/plus aliasing) so equivalent addresses are recognized as the same account, then built a duplicate-detection utility on top of that normalization to find accounts using aliased variants of the same email. The transcript's claim of a failing "dotless-domain" test and a "3 of 4 passing" state isn't reflected in any visible test file in the diff, so that detail can't be verified from the evidence shown.
